description_en: A drafting stool with a narrow woven seat and small curved lumbar back on an adjustable metal column clad with bamboo; the front shows the round foot ring, the side reveals the column sleeve and back-support arm, and the rear exposes the lumbar bracket. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A drafting stool with a narrow woven seat and small curved lumbar back on an adjustable metal column clad with bamboo; the front shows the round foot ring, the side reveals the column sleeve and back-support arm, and the rear exposes the lumbar bracket. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.. Style Royal: formal symmetry and graceful bound borders without emblems. Relative size medium within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
